_comment: Singapore — Trade Classification, Customs and Excise Duties (STCCED), 2022 edition, the current one. Singapore publishes NO machine-readable schedule: the only source is a 655-page PDF (https://file.go.gov.sg/stcced2022.pdf) linked from customs.gov.sg. So acquisition is manual, like the Dominican Republic's: the PDF is fetched by hand into data/sg_tariff_source/.sg_download/ and scripts/hts_automation/parse_sg_stcced.py converts it, writing sg_tariff_<year>_rev_<n>.csv (+ its .meta.json effective date) for the manual adapter, and the legal-notes corpus under data/hts_notes/. Codes are 8-digit; hierarchy is the dash depth the book prints. Sources: SOURCES.md.
_comment_revision: Revision ids follow the {year}_rev_{number} convention every jurisdiction uses. A dated edition takes MMDD of its effective date as the number, as CH (901), KR (101) and TW (729) do: the 2022 edition, effective 1 January 2022 (the HS 2022 date; the PDF states none of its own), is 2022_rev_101.
_comment_verify: Copied from DO. The first edition has no predecessor, so verify passes with a warning (diff_revisions.py writes {"skipped": "no_previous"}); the thresholds guard the next edition.
